config.sectionText:
Apply the latest content or settings from the configured source control repository to FortiSOAR.


The content will be applied using FortiSOAR's default configuration, including items such as playbooks, module definitions, connectors, and other system components.


This is especially important when:

  • You need to apply updates without manual intervention.
  • You want to apply content using the default FortiSOAR configuration.

⚠️ Note: FortiSOAR will be temporarily unavailable to all users during the publishing process.

config.sectionText:
Select a source control repository to review and pull the latest content or settings into FortiSOAR.


You can review and edit the export templates to include or exclude recent changes from the content or settings repository, such as playbooks, module definitions, connectors, and other components.


This is especially important when:

  • A new set of playbooks needs to be imported into FortiSOAR.
  • A newly created module should be published and tracked.

⚠️ Note: FortiSOAR will be temporarily unavailable to all users during the publishing process.

FortiSOAR export template to define what content will be exported from FortiSOAR and saved to a source control system (e.g., GitHub).


Templates like "Source Control - Production Content" determine which items - such as playbooks, module definitions, connectors, and other components - are included in the export.

You can review and modify these templates to include or exclude specific content.


Use this when you've created new playbooks, modules, or other content that should be included in source control.


Purpose of export template is outlined below:

  • Source Control - Production Settings: This setting includes module records, system views, application configurations, environment variables, account configurations, LDAP, SSO, and RADIUS settings from the production environment, all of which are backed up or synchronized to this repository.

FortiSOAR export template to define what content will be exported from FortiSOAR and saved to a source control system (e.g., GitHub).


Templates like "Source Control - Production Content" determine which items - such as playbooks, module definitions, connectors, and other components - are included in the export.

You can review and modify these templates to include or exclude specific content.


Use this when you've created new playbooks, modules, or other content that should be included in source control.


Purpose of each export template is outlined below:

  • Source Control - Production Content: This template is intended to define customizations for any existing or new content, such as playbooks, connectors, roles, and module schemas.
  • Source Control - Development Settings: This setting includes module records, system views, application configurations, environment variables, account configurations, LDAP, SSO, and RADIUS settings from the development environment, all of which are backed up or synchronized to this repository.
